quest.title: Wanderings of a Lonesome Shadow
quest.description: After getting free of her academic tangles, Faruzan decides to first go to Pardis Dhyai...

talks.objective: Talk with Tighnari as you wait for the results

dialogues.speaker: Tired Villager
dialogues.text: The ruins? Don't know anything. We were only hired to deliver water and supplies to them.

dialogues.speaker: Tired Villager
dialogues.text: Forget excavation — they won't even let us get close to the camp where they're staying.

talks.objective: Go to the northeast of Hypostyle Desert

dialogues.speaker: Curious Villager
dialogues.text: This area used to be ravaged by frequent sandstorms, but it's been calm lately for some reason...

dialogues.speaker: Curious Villager
dialogues.text: They say that this was done by a single traveler? But seriously, is such a thing even humanly possible?

dialogues.speaker: Chatty Villager
dialogues.text: That machine looks amazing! Could it be the legendary Ruin Wanderer?

dialogues.speaker: Chatty Villager
dialogues.text: The location seems to fit too... Might that legend actually be true?

talks.objective: Organize the gathered information with Faruzan

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Note
dialogues.text: "...Tamimi's remodeling is going smoothly. As it is now, it can learn how to deal with various dangerous situations in the ruins on its own. I wish you could see it with your own eyes."

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Note
dialogues.text: "As I worked, I kept thinking that you'd do a better job at this than I could."

dialogues.speaker: Yellowed Note
dialogues.text: "After all, you're the most exceptional student I've ever met."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Keep Tamimi a secret...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Tell the whole truth...)

dialogues.speaker: Karkata
dialogues.text: Kolu...

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: Who knew that I'd encounter a mechanical life form in this manner after a hundred years?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I didn't know mechanical life forms could get sick, too... You have to get better soon, Karkata!

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: A "Fully Automated Irrigation System"... That's quite the task.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Master, can I help with anything at all? I can go buy things, prepare pen and paper...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Oh, you know, I seem to remember that you have a lot of homework today.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Huh? O—Oh, yeah, I do...

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Well, hurry up and finish it so you can sleep early, or Faruzan will worry. That's the best thing you can do now to help.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh... Okay...

dialogues.speaker: Karkata
dialogues.text: Kolu...

dialogues.speaker: Bakr
dialogues.text: Halt! Mr. Raed's permission is required to proceed any further!

dialogues.speaker: Raed
dialogues.text: There's a tent that the villagers occasionally use to rest. Like I said, it's a bit simple, yes, but I hope you won't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Raed
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry for disturbing your rest. I'll tell my subordinates to be quieter in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Machine Wreckage
dialogues.text: (The wreckage of the huge machine remains motionless...)

dialogues.speaker: Faruzan
dialogues.text: (Faruzan's head hangs low in silence... The desert breathes gales of wind, and the only sound that can be heard is the scattering rise of spreading grains.)

dialogues.speaker: Karkata
dialogues.text: Kalu! Kalu!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: It looks fine, but even so, it needs to properly rest up.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: Faruzan went out after repairing Karkata. She seems to be looking for you for some reason.

dialogues.speaker: Tighnari
dialogues.text: ...Well, I will not probe any further. However, if you need any help, do feel free to ask.

dialogues.speaker: Tired Villager
dialogues.text: Ugh... So we still can't go back to Aaru Village?

dialogues.speaker: Curious Villager
dialogues.text: Just what are they digging for?

dialogues.speaker: Chatty Villager
dialogues.text: That huge machine looks amazing!

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Penned Note
dialogues.text: "Dear Madam Faruzan..."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Penned Note
dialogues.text: "The notes and manuscripts we found on Tamimi have been transcribed and organized, and every one of them has been marked with your name."

dialogues.speaker: Neatly-Penned Note
dialogues.text: "I hope that even after a hundred years, future generations of students will still remember your name, Madam Faruzan."

dialogues.speaker: Oft-Corrected Note
dialogues.text: "... I told you not to... Now, look... So many people... Worried... Even... Tamimi..."

dialogues.speaker: Oft-Corrected Note
dialogues.text: (The messy scribbling has been repeatedly canceled and edited, leaving barely legible phrases and a single neat message at the back.)

dialogues.speaker: Oft-Corrected Note
dialogues.text: "Hurry up and come home for a meal. Your mom always makes an extra portion of food, you know?"

dialogues.speaker: Karkata
dialogues.text: Kolu...
